note: Barnes County and its largest city Valley City publish zoning only as PDF documents (county development code; Valley City 2025 Zoning Districts Map PDF). No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable polygon layer of zoning districts was found on the county site, the city site, the ND GIS Hub or ArcGIS Online; the only zoning polygons found were in unrelated counties. Barnes County's parcel dataset has empty zoning fields.
